values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $34 a night for the 159 20/30-amp (or 20-amp) sites, $39 for the 55 sites with 50-amp service (both loops; 2027-05-18 and 07-13 alike). 2026: $32 / $37 (booking site, 2026-10-27; the DNR rates table lists the $32 20/30-amp rate). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Metamora-Hadley North and South maps: fee schedule -32691 feeTotal $34 and fee schedule -31438 (the 50-amp sites) $39 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13, $32 / $37 for 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Metamora-Hadley, North and South Loops: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $32) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/metamora ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 214 North and South campsites: 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Water Hookup=No', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 55 list 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 123 '20 Amps/30 Amps', 36 '20 Amps') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/metamora (tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 214 campsites: 89 in the North loop and 125 in the South loop, every one with electric. Allowed rigs run up to 20-50 ft (14 North sites take 50 ft; 196 sites take 25 ft or more; 6 South sites are for tents and truck campers only). Four pull-throughs (North 146 and 190, South 1 and 3). One camper cabin in the North loop, plus 20 overflow sites.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/metamora (Metamora-Hadley Modern Campground: 'Number of sites: 214'; tags 'Pull-through sites available') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (maps 'North' (89 campsites + Camper Cabin) and 'South' (125 campsites); per-site allowed equipment up to 'Trailer or RV up to 50''; 'Pull Through=Yes' on 4 sites; map 'Auxiliary' 20 Overflow sites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Toilet/shower building open for the whole reservation season (DNR rates table). The two-lane sanitation station in the modern campground has potable water. Camp store at the campground entrance.

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

note: Modern campground in two loops on 80-acre Lake Minnawanna, 8 mi south of Lapeer: the north loop is more open and grassy with some campsites on the water, the south loop more wooded. Camp store at the entrance rents bikes and paddling gear (810-797-2300). The day-use area (beach, buoyed swim area, pavilion, Minnawanna boat launch) is closed spring and summer 2027 for dam repairs, since its only road crosses the dam; the campground and trails stay open (DNR park page, read 2026-10-25). --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: 214 sites (confirmed), all electric, 50-amp at 55 (electric 50 confirmed; water/sewer false new), rigs to 50 ft, 4 pull-throughs (new), toilet/shower building + sanitation station (dump confirmed; showers/flush new), reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed), reservation season April 1 - Nov 5 (booking.season new). Fees 32-32 -> 34-39 (2027 booking site; 2026 $32/$37). Season left as stored (year_round false; no page states the operating season). Phone 810-797-4439 matches. The note's 'some ... non-electric' sites contradicted by the booking site (every campsite has electric) and dropped; field restatements trimmed; the 2027 day-use closure added with its date.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'lakeview', but the DNR page says 'The north loop offers some campsites on the water'.

Day-use closure (not a campground closure): 'Due to dam repairs, the day-use area, including public beach, buoyed swim area, pavilion and Minnawanna boating access site, will be closed spring and summer 2027 ... The campground and trails will remain open.' Recorded in the note only.
